sentiment.rationale: This pre-earnings digest describes strongly bullish sentiment and high expectations heading into the report, with analysts expecting revenue of $54.9-$54.98 billion (+56.7% YoY) and a TipRanks Smart Score of 9. The document also notes that management's own prior guidance had already set a high bar of $65 billion for the following quarter, indicating that expectations are stretched. Such elevated expectations leave little room for a positive surprise, increasing the risk of a negative market reaction even if results are decent, hence a bearish score.
